evaluation_basis: Frozen IMG-01 method + Stage-0 + family definitions + mechanical preflight only. Director prior language is not used as criterion, prompt repair, or tie-break.

promotion_floor.HUMAN_SPECIFICITY: PASS - three adults are specific, differentiated, and human-first rather than avatar-like.
promotion_floor.REPRESENTATION_DEPTH_CONTINUITY: PASS_WITH_RESERVATION - silhouette, proportion, hair and clothing-structure cues are strong enough to support reduction, while this one full-figure exemplar does not itself prove every depth.
promotion_floor.RELATIONAL_CAUSAL_MEANING: PASS_WITH_RESERVATION - A/B relational orientation is immediate and C remains specific/present; the completed changed-present condition is comparatively weak/ambiguous.
promotion_floor.STAGE_PRIMACY_NONCOPY: PASS - no cone, spotlight, black-box theater or copied Stage carrier.
promotion_floor.CROSS_SURFACE_TRANSLATION: PASS_WITH_USAGE_RESTRAINT - figure-led art can expand on WEB and reduce on APP, but should remain concentrated at identity-bearing moments.
promotion_floor.IMAGE_FALLBACK_SEMANTIC_SURVIVAL: PASS - mechanical preflight already proves complete no-image fallback.
promotion_floor.MONOCHROME_HIGH_CONTRAST_DURABILITY: PASS - mechanical preflight plus strong non-color silhouette/form cues.
promotion_floor.CLR_INDEPENDENCE: PASS - current result is value/form-led and creates no CLR selection.

secondary_dimensions.NON_GENERIC_AI_ART_DIRECTION: RESERVATION - the result approaches familiar editorial/cinematic lifestyle illustration; specificity keeps it above outright generic portrait failure, but this pressure must remain explicit.
secondary_dimensions.USAGE_RESTRAINT: REQUIRED - do not turn every shell/supporting surface into a figurative editorial scene.

family_results.design_sol_read: Strongest current exemplar because human specificity and relational legibility survive without Stage copying; it earns survival, not final selection.

family_results.name: Transforming Human Invariants

promotion_floor.HUMAN_SPECIFICITY: PASS - all three adults remain specific and non-interchangeable.
promotion_floor.REPRESENTATION_DEPTH_CONTINUITY: FAIL_CURRENT_EXEMPLAR - the renderer returned conventional full-figure representation and did not materially demonstrate transformation across crop/completeness/orientation or reduced-depth invariants.
promotion_floor.RELATIONAL_CAUSAL_MEANING: PASS_WITH_RESERVATION - A/B relation is readable and the broken shared barrier suggests a changed present, but authorship/causal attribution remains ambiguous.
promotion_floor.STAGE_PRIMACY_NONCOPY: PASS - no copied Stage carrier or cone/scenery shorthand.
promotion_floor.CROSS_SURFACE_TRANSLATION: FAIL_CURRENT_EXEMPLAR - because the intended transformable-invariant mechanism did not visibly materialize, this output does not yet prove a distinct APP/WEB translation law beyond F1-like figurative illustration.
promotion_floor.IMAGE_FALLBACK_SEMANTIC_SURVIVAL: PASS - mechanical preflight already proves complete no-image fallback.
promotion_floor.MONOCHROME_HIGH_CONTRAST_DURABILITY: PASS_MECHANICALLY / NOT_FULLY_PROVEN_AESTHETICALLY - structural cues exist, but the family-specific transformation claim is under-materialized.
promotion_floor.CLR_INDEPENDENCE: PASS - no palette selection or color-only identity.

secondary_dimensions.NON_GENERIC_AI_ART_DIRECTION: RESERVATION - the output collapses toward familiar contemplative editorial/cinematic illustration instead of a visibly distinct transformable identity system.

family_results.design_sol_read: The family thesis remains conceptually valuable, but this first output does not earn survival because its defining representation mechanism failed to transfer. Any rescue would require a separately authorized successor/refinement gate; this run cannot be retuned after result exposure.

family_results.name: Grounded Residual Presence

promotion_floor.HUMAN_SPECIFICITY: PASS - three specific adults remain identifiable and human.
promotion_floor.REPRESENTATION_DEPTH_CONTINUITY: PASS_WITH_RESERVATION - non-color figure cues exist, though this image does not test multiple depths.
promotion_floor.RELATIONAL_CAUSAL_MEANING: FAIL - the large sculptural field dominates interpretation; the changed condition is visible, but human authorship/relationship is weaker than the object itself.
promotion_floor.STAGE_PRIMACY_NONCOPY: PASS - no literal Stage carrier is copied.
promotion_floor.CROSS_SURFACE_TRANSLATION: FAIL_CURRENT_EXEMPLAR - the field/object is too dominant to translate safely into restrained APP contexts without becoming the visual system itself.
promotion_floor.IMAGE_FALLBACK_SEMANTIC_SURVIVAL: PASS - mechanical preflight already proves complete no-image fallback.
promotion_floor.MONOCHROME_HIGH_CONTRAST_DURABILITY: PASS_MECHANICALLY - structural field/figure separation survives without color.

secondary_dimensions.NON_GENERIC_AI_ART_DIRECTION: FAIL_PRESSURE - reads close to architectural/concept-art spectacle rather than a uniquely human-causal image law.
secondary_dimensions.USAGE_RESTRAINT: FAIL_CURRENT_EXEMPLAR - expressive field response visually outranks the people.

family_results.hard_failure_basis: Decorative/material atmosphere weakens relational/causal meaning and the environment/material spectacle outranks people; the dominant sculptural wave behaves like the giant symbolic object the renderer packet explicitly prohibited.
family_results.design_sol_read: The output proves the family can make consequence visible, but it does so by sacrificing human primacy. Under the frozen conjunctive method this is a rejection, not a prompt-fix invitation.

survivor_restrictions: Use figurative imagery selectively at identity-bearing or relational moments; avoid generic editorial/campaign repetition; keep quiet shell/supporting surfaces image-light or image-free.
comparative_conclusion.reason: F1 is the only raw exemplar that clears the frozen conjunctive promotion floor without a hard failure. It best preserves human specificity and relationship while keeping environment subordinate and Stage uncopied. F2's defining transformable-invariant mechanism did not visibly transfer; F3 makes consequence visible by letting environmental spectacle outrank people.

director_prior_disposition.next_step: After this method-bound view is frozen durably, perform a separate concordance audit against the quarantined Director qualitative prior without changing any IMG-01 score or criterion.
